correctness.rationale: The discriminant criterion proves exactly which 91 of 121 models are smooth and genus three. Three explicit involutions and character eigenspaces prove decomposition of the whole Frobenius H1, so each zeta numerator is an exact product of three elliptic quadratics. Each of 91 finite tuples is exhaustively evaluated by exact F_11 character sums, direct independent octic point counts, and F_121 point counts in two distinct field models; complete 28-row CSV and all 91 tuples check. The 36/55 split-versus-conjugate partition is also proved by counting unordered roots of the quadratic in quartic parameters. Risks are implementation and convention errors, mitigated by independent full enumeration and geometric proof.

value.rationale: This is a complete natural arithmetic invariant of the full F_11-rational two-dimensional reciprocal Howe family, not an arbitrary isolated example. It resolves a genuine Galois descent distinction: 20 of the 28 isogeny types exist only when the two quartic factors are conjugate over F_121. The tabulation determines every extension-field point count and the sharp marked-family maximum. The result is independent of any generic downstream theorem and is not a mere renaming of the previously computed five F_9 split spectra.
